:::{#exm-sensitivity}
#### Sensitivity of a COVID-19 test

Suppose a COVID-19 test is positive for 99% of the people who have COVID-19.
Let $D$ be the event "the person has COVID-19"
and $+$ the event "the test is positive".
Then the test's sensitivity (@def-sensitivity) is:

$$\Pr(+ \mid D) = 0.99$$

:::
